WELCOME, DIRECTOR.
A NEW FIRM AWAITS ITS FIRST DEPLOYMENT.
intro.move: Tap a street to move. Double-tap to hurry — faster, but louder and easier to spot.
intro.goal: Take contracts, work them, then hold your HQ with EVAC to bank everything you earned.
intro.stance: Stance chips: SNEAK plus cover is what actually defeats a patrol.
intro.board: CITY INFO: your contract board, plus the log, your Firm, the city, rival Firms and a LEGEND of every mark.
intro.evac: EVAC: raise the beacon and hold your HQ until the dropship arrives.
intro.radar: The radar. The ringed emblem is your HQ — that is home, and where the dropship lands.
toast.agentDumped: An operative was dumped at the door
toast.areaAssetTaken: Asset secured — get to the door
dialog.cubby.greet: A narrow service recess. Dark enough, if you fold yourself in.

dialog.respond.waitDark: Rest. I'll wake you when it's dark.
dialog.respond.cubbyHide: You fold into the recess and wait for the light to die.

legend.mark.civilian: A civilian. Not a threat, and never a target

legend.stance.move: The default. Normal speed, normal noise
